Part-Time Assistant (PTA) – Bain & Company, Shanghai

About the Role:
We are looking for exceptional undergraduate or graduate students to join our Shanghai office as Part-Time Assistants. You will support case teams in research, analysis, and presentation preparation.

Responsibilities:
- Conduct market research and competitive analysis to support client engagements
- Synthesize data from multiple sources into clear, actionable insights
- Prepare high-quality PowerPoint presentations for client meetings
- Assist in financial modeling and data analysis tasks
- Collaborate with consultants and managers across different workstreams

Requirements:
- Currently enrolled in a top-tier undergraduate or graduate program
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Excellent communication skills in both English and Mandarin
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
- Ability to work 2-3 days per week

Preferred:
- Previous internship experience in consulting, finance, or strategy
- Leadership experience in student organizations
- Familiarity with business frameworks and case analysis
